caption: The drawing depicts a metallic pitcher with a conical lid topped by a small finial. The pitcher is rendered in shades of grey and silver, giving it a reflective quality typical of pewter or silverware. The spout of the pitcher is ornate, with decorative elements at the base, while the handle on the opposite side is elongated and curves upward with a scroll-like embellishment at its upper end. The body of the pitcher is cylindrical and widens slightly toward the base, which is ringed by two circular bands. An etched pattern of a leaf with a curved stem and small detailing adorns the side of the pitcher. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detailing present.
title: Ice Water Pitcher
